description.value: The House Hotel Saloon is a refreshment stop inside Barkerville Historic Town & Park, western North America's largest living history museum and a National Historic Site of Canada. Situated in Building #19 along the heritage townsite's main street, it offers root beer, ice cream, and Barkerville Brewery beer on tap in a roomy, period-appropriate saloon setting. For touring cyclists riding the Cariboo region, it provides a unique mid-route rest point within a living 1860s Gold Rush townscape.
